order: [iy, ix], iy=0 south; cell centre x0+(ix+0.5)dx

sources.dem: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) bare-earth DEM, elevation.nationalmap.gov ImageServer, NAVD88 m; bay surface is hydro-flattened at -1.07 m in the source.
sources.buildings: DataSF Building Footprints (ynuv-fyni), 2010 lidar heights (hgt_median_m, gnd_min_m).
sources.assessor: SF Assessor-Recorder Secured Property Tax Roll 2023 (DataSF wv5m-vpq2).
sources.hazus_occ: FEMA Hazus 6.1 Inventory Technical Manual (2024), Table 3-2 occupancy classes.
sources.hazus_contents: FEMA Hazus 6.1 Flood Technical Manual (2024), contents value as % of structure replacement value: RES 50%, COM 100% (COM6/COM7 150%, COM10 50%), IND 150%, AGR/REL/GOV1/EDU1 100%, GOV2/EDU2 150%.
sources.repl_cost: Replacement (hard) cost per m2 of gross floor area, San Francisco: Rider Levett Bucknall Quarterly Construction Cost Report Q3 2025 (rlb.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2025/09/Q3-2025-QCR.pdf): prime office $460-800/sf, secondary office $360-580/sf, 3-star hotel $430-660/sf; RLB Q3 2024 via The Real Deal 11.10.2024: multifamily $400-625/sf, single-family $330-550/sf. Midpoints used (1 sf = 0.0929 m2). Retail/industrial/civic: estimates scaled from these. Method as Hazus 6.1 (cost/area x floor area).
sources.inlets: SFPUC Stormwater inlets (DataSF jtgq-b7c5). Capacity per FHWA HEC-22 (Urban Drainage Design Manual, 3rd ed., FHWA-NHI-10-009) grate/curb inlet interception for a ~0.6x0.9 m SF catch-basin grate at ~5-10 cm ponding: 0.03-0.06 m3/s.
sources.trees: DataSF Street Tree Inventory (tkzw-k3nq). Height/crown allometry: form after McPherson, van Doorn & Peper 2016, Urban Tree Database (USFS GTR PSW-253), simplified per form group. Green modulus of rupture: USDA FPL Wood Handbook (FPL-GTR-282, 2021) Table 5-3a/5-4a where the genus is listed; others default 40 MPa.
sources.streets: DataSF Streets active and retired (3psu-pn9h) centerlines; SF Better Streets Plan typical roadway widths (residential ~12 m curb-curb, arterial ~16-20 m).
sources.parks: SF Recreation and Parks Properties (DataSF gtr9-ntp6).
sources.flood100: SFPUC 100-Year Storm Flood Risk Map (DataSF jzu3-4yxp).
sources.validation: SF 311 Cases (DataSF vw6y-z8j6), 30.12.2022-01.01.2023: Sewer Issues (Flooding, Sewage_back_up) and Tree Maintenance.
sources.cars: Synthetic parked cars along curbs of DataSF street centerlines (~6.5 m stall). Value: Kelley Blue Book / Cox Automotive average used-vehicle listing price ~US$25k (2024-25).
sources.soil: Infiltration ksat: Rawls, Brakensiek & Miller 1983 (Green-Ampt parameters; loamy sand ~30 mm/h, sandy loam ~11 mm/h), reduced for urban compaction; Manning n: Chow 1959 / HEC-RAS 2D manual.
